{{Top|leg}}
A '''multiprocessor''' was the term used for any [[Starship/Legends|starship]] system that was capable of handling more than one task. Usually, food preparation, disposal and water reclamation were the tasks allocated to a multiprocessor. [[Hot chocolate/Legends|Hot chocolate]] could be made using a multiprocessor.
